snippet.title: Lost in The Roots. Teaser
snippet.description:
A 2D adventure with a twisted story about guilt, where a girl is kidnapped and held in an attic somewhere in the countryside. Why and who took the girl to this godforsaken place? What to do when there is nowhere to run?

Add to wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2872240/Lost_in_the_Roots/
